blurb_zh: 工作日和周末的客流差
scene_zh: 一条城市地铁线网的日均客流（模拟数据）

views.subject: Weekday and weekend metro ridership
views.subtitle_en: Average daily rides across the network, January 2024 to December 2025.

examples.en: Weekday ridership bottomed out at 7.6 million in February 2024.
examples.zh: 2024 年 2 月工作日客流触底，为 760 万人次。

features.note_zh: bottom out 是“触底”的口语短语，后接 at + 数值；书面可换 reach its lowest point。
features.interpret_zh: 二月低谷与春节假期时间接近，但图里只有月份，没有节假日数据，不能据此断定原因。

examples.en: Weekday ridership climbed from 11.2 million in March to 11.6 million in May 2024.
examples.zh: 2024 年 3 月到 5 月，工作日客流从 1120 万人次升到 1160 万人次。

features.note_zh: climb 暗示一段一段往上走，适合连续多个区间；这里两个区间都在涨。
features.interpret_zh: 涨幅只有约 40 万人次，用 steady 可以，但说“大幅增长”就过头了。

examples.en: Weekday ridership rose steadily through the summer of 2025, from 11.7 million in June to 12.2 million in August.
examples.zh: 2025 年夏天工作日客流稳步上升，从 6 月的 1170 万人次升到 8 月的 1220 万人次。

features.note_zh: through the summer 概括整个季节；from…to… 给出起止月份和数值。
features.interpret_zh: 三个月增加约 50 万人次；夏季上升可能与旅游季重叠，但图里没有旅游数据，只能描述走势。

examples.en: Weekday ridership peaked in August 2025, at 12.2 million.
examples.zh: 工作日客流在 2025 年 8 月达到峰值 1220 万人次。

features.note_zh: peak 作动词直接跟 in + 月份、at + 数值，不需要再加 reach a peak。
features.interpret_zh: 这是 24 个月样本里的最高点，不能推断之后不会更高。

examples.en: Weekend ridership also peaked in August 2025, at 8.7 million, well below the weekday figure.
examples.zh: 周末客流同样在 2025 年 8 月见顶，为 870 万人次，明显低于工作日。

features.note_zh: well below 比 lower than 语气更强，适合差距明显时使用。
features.interpret_zh: 两条线同月见顶，但周末始终只有工作日的约七成，不能用周末数据推算工作日运力需求。

views.overview_zh: 工作日客流两年里大多在 1100 万到 1220 万人次之间，周末约为其七成。2024 和 2025 年的二月都明显下探，2025 年 8 月两条线同时见顶。月度数据无法说明单日波动，也没有解释涨跌原因。

general.a2: Weekday metro ridership was about 11 million rides a day for most of the two years. Weekends were lower, at about 8 million. Both series dropped in February and reached their highest point in August.
general.b1: Weekday ridership stayed between 10.9 and 12.2 million rides a day, with sharp dips in February 2024 and February 2025. Weekend ridership followed the same shape at a lower level, peaking at 8.7 million in August 2025. Both series recovered within a month of each February low.
general.b2: Over the two years, weekday ridership moved in a narrow band of 10.9 to 12.2 million rides a day, apart from two February troughs when it fell below 8.5 million. Weekend ridership tracked the same seasonal shape at roughly 70 percent of the weekday level. The August 2025 peak was the highest point in the sample, and the series shows no sustained upward trend across the period.

descriptions.ielts: Weekday ridership fluctuated between 7.6 and 12.2 million rides a day over the two-year period. It dipped sharply in both Februaries and peaked at 12.2 million in August 2025. Weekend ridership followed a similar pattern but remained about 30 percent lower throughout.
descriptions.business: Weekday demand held at roughly 11 to 12 million rides a day, while weekends ran at about 70 percent of that level. The two February dips are the only major interruptions, and both reversed within a month. For capacity planning, the August peak matters more than the spring average: weekday volume reached 12.2 million.

views.subject: Daily metro entries by station
views.subtitle_en: Average daily entries at six major stations.

examples.en: Central Square is the busiest station, with 186,000 entries a day.
examples.zh: 中央广场站最忙，日均进站 18.6 万人次。

features.note_zh: the busiest station 是描述客流最自然的名词搭配；具体数值用 with 引出。
features.interpret_zh: 这是六个站的样本，不能说明它是全网客流量最大的站。

examples.en: Main Rail Station ranks second, at 152,000 entries a day.
examples.zh: 火车总站排第二，日均进站 15.2 万人次。

features.note_zh: rank second 不加 the；口语里也可以说 comes second。
features.interpret_zh: 比第一名少 3.4 万人次，差距不算悬殊。

examples.en: Airport T2 records 104,000 entries a day, well below Central Square's 186,000.
examples.zh: 机场 T2 日均进站 10.4 万人次，明显低于中央广场的 18.6 万。

features.note_zh: well below + 数值 表示差距明显；名词所有格后直接接数字即可。
features.interpret_zh: 机场站客流受航班时刻影响，日均值会抹平一天内的波动。

examples.en: Tech Park handles 79,000 entries a day.
examples.zh: 科技园站日均进站 7.9 万人次。

features.note_zh: handle 在交通语境里指“承载”，比 have 更具体。
features.interpret_zh: 79,000 是日均值，工作日与周末可能差别很大，图里看不出来。

examples.en: Old Town has the lowest figure, at 63,000 entries a day.
examples.zh: 老城站数值最低，日均进站 6.3 万人次。

features.note_zh: the lowest figure 是图表描述里最稳的说法；直接说 the quietest station 也可以。
features.interpret_zh: 最低只在这六个站里成立，不代表它在整条线网里真的冷清。

views.overview_zh: 六个站里中央广场和火车总站明显领先，两站合计 33.8 万人次，与其余四站合计的 33.3 万几乎相当。大学城和科技园只差 8,000 人次。这张图只比较日均进站量，不含换乘和出站客流。

general.a2: Central Square is the busiest station, with 186,000 entries a day. Main Rail Station comes next at 152,000. Old Town is the quietest of the six, at 63,000.
general.b1: Daily entries range from 186,000 at Central Square to 63,000 at Old Town. The top two stations are well ahead of the rest, while University Town and Tech Park are close at 87,000 and 79,000.
general.b2: Entries fall steeply from the top two stations to the rest: Central Square and Main Rail Station handle 186,000 and 152,000 entries a day, while no other station exceeds 104,000. University Town and Tech Park are separated by just 8,000 entries, so the chart cannot tell us much about which is busier in practice.

descriptions.ielts: Central Square recorded the highest number of daily entries, at 186,000, followed by Main Rail Station at 152,000. Airport T2 came third with 104,000, while Old Town had the lowest figure at 63,000.
descriptions.business: The network is concentrated in two hubs: Central Square and Main Rail Station handle 338,000 entries a day, close to the 333,000 handled by the other four combined. That concentration matters for crowd management and retail placement, and it means disruption at either hub has an outsized effect.
